title.en: A dry run refuses koshari on a robot with no oil thermometer

goal.en: See the standard's first rule in action: before anything heats up, a device checks every step and refuses what it cannot verify. Deep frying has exactly one rung on its sensor ladder, an oil thermometer.

note.en: Ask the hub which recipes it can plan; the example set includes koshari.
Dry-run koshari on a kitchen robot that has a hob but no thermometers. A person is in the kitchen, so cutting and sautéing may run.
Same recipe on a robot with an oil thermometer: accepted, with a plan that says which rung verifies each step.
The accepted plan still has every step; nothing was skipped to make it pass.

outcome.en: You have seen a refusal with a reason and a node id, and an acceptance with a plan. Next: scenario 002 shows the same check from a browser, and scenario 010 adds a person-absent run.
